issues.on_page: General Fund Taxes 7,893,411 (budget 8,926,966); p2 Property 7,166,466 + Motor vehicle 726,945 = 7,893,411
issues.issue: Correctly restored as printed (label, amount, budget and page match). It is kept unsplit, which is defensible: the p2 breakdown is county-wide and the General Fund line has no tax-type columns. But the tie is exact to the dollar. A person may want to settle whether that counts as a proven breakdown (rule 1) or a coincidence (rule 5).
